C1177.title: Instagram 2026 Data Scraping Incident: 17 Million Account Records Exposed via API Abuse
C1177.summary: In 2026, a threat actor claimed to possess information on about 17 million Instagram accounts and said the data came from 2024 collection through an insufficiently secured Instagram API, but the claim was not confirmed. Meta/Instagram denied that a system data breach had occurred. The incident is better treated as a suspected large-scale scraping and API abuse claim rather than a confirmed data breach.
